title: Disney Revival Shares First Look at Final Season
content: Disney has become a mainstay in the animation world, with silver screen offerings like The Lion King, Moana, Inside Out , and Toy Story being only a few examples of movies that have elevated the studio.
author: ComicBook

title: Once Upon a Katamari Game Gets Switch 2 Version, 'Rolling Live Highlights' DLC on October 8
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment announced on Wednesday that Once Upon a Katamari , its new game in the Katamari Damacy franchise , is getting a Nintendo Switch 2 version on October 8. In addition, a new "Rolling LIVE Highlights" DLC will launch on the same day.
author: ANN

title: Manga Creator Ryoichiro Kezuka Dies
content: Kezuka launched the Record Journey ( Onban Kikō ) manga in Aokishi magazine in 2021. Titan Manga is releasing the manga in English. Kezuka initially self-published his Otomachi Record manga series. Kadokawa later published the series in January 2023 and shipped the second volume in February 2023.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Removes Legendary Anime Series
content: For years, Crunchyroll has been one of the premier spots for housing some of the oldest and newest anime favorites around. While many of the shows that are a part of the platform’s library might be viewed on other services, Crunchyroll has had its fair share of exclusives.
author: ComicBook

title: ChaO Anime Film Opens in Indian Theaters on August 7
content: The film opened in Japan in August 2025. The film screened in 16 countries and regions around the world. GKIDS licensed ChaO , and it describes the story: From acclaimed Japanese animation production house Studio 4°C comes a wild romantic comedy and true “fish out of water” story.
author: ANN

title: FLOW's Naruto-Themed Tour Goes to Hong Kong, Singapore, Bangkok, Taipei, Manila
content: Sony Music Entertainment 's Sacra Music label announced on Monday that rock band FLOW 's Naruto franchise -themed concert tour " FLOW World Tour 2026 ' Naruto the Rock'" will have stops in Hong Kong, Singapore, Bangkok, Taipei, and Manila.
author: ANN

title: New Akira Print Will Be Reissued in U.K. Cinemas From August
content: Anime Limited has announced on its X/Twitter feed that a new 35mm print of Katsuhiro Ōtomo 's classic 1988 film Akira will be reissued in UK cinemas from August. According to Anime Limited , this is the first new print of the film created in decades.
author: ANN

title: Sword Art Online: Alicization Singer ASCA to Perform at Anime India Mumbai 2026
content: The next Anime India event will take place from August 28 through August 30 at NESCO Goregaon. Naruto director Hayato Date ( Naruto Shippūden , Flame of Recca ) will attend the upcoming Mumbai event as a guest. Voice actor Akari Yura ( The Beginning After The End , Catch Me at the Ballpark!

title: Crunchyroll to Stream The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom Anime in India
content: Crunchyroll announced on Monday that it will stream the anime adaptation of Hifumi 's The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom ( Yūkyū no Gusha Asley no, Kenja no Susume ) light novel series in the Indian subcontinent.
